welcome.title: Welcome to Langora!
welcome.desc: Let's customize your linguistic journey. We'll set up your target language, evaluate your goals, and estimate your initial proficiency level.

language.title: What language do you want to learn?
language.desc: Select your target language. You can change this later.
language.en_desc: Learn grammar, professional vocab, or prep for IELTS/TOEIC.
language.ja_desc: Master kanji, JLPT vocabulary, and natural speaking.
language.zh_desc: Practice tones, HSK vocab, and characters (Coming Soon).

goal.title: What is your learning goal?
goal.desc: We will personalize your roadmap to focus on these topics.
goal.ielts_desc: Focus on formal vocabulary, academic essays, and coherence.
goal.toeic_desc: Focus on corporate vocabulary, emails, and active grammar.
goal.business_desc: Prepare for negotiations, corporate presentations, and writing emails.
goal.travel_desc: Improve basic dialogues, vocab, and speaking fluency.

level.title: Estimate your current level
level.desc: This helps us feed the right content to your AI recommendations.
level.beginner_desc: I am starting from scratch. I don't know basic vocabulary or grammar yet.
level.intermediate_desc: I can construct basic paragraphs and comprehend slow conversations.
level.advanced_desc: I communicate fluently but need to master complex grammar and style structures.
level.unsure_label: I am not sure (Recommend Placement Test)
level.unsure_desc: Take a 5-minute AI assessment to test your reading, vocab, and syntax.

placement.title: AI Placement Test
placement.instruction: Choose the word that best fits the sentence below:

result.vocab_desc: Strong in general business, moderate in science.
result.writing_desc: Clear logical flow. Minor errors in complex tenses.
result.ai_desc: We've created a custom roadmap for you. We suggest focusing on 'Conditional Structures' in grammar and 'Negotiation Idioms' in vocabulary.
